_comment: d1 #247 FoTI extension -- the QUEST-GATE proof. Off inn_guests_gate_start, which is inn_guests_ext_start minus rags_meeting_settled (chieftains_price is open, its price named, nothing handed over) and otherwise byte-identical, INCLUDING chatted_with_rags. That is the whole subject: met is not enough for a quest-gated guest. WIInnGuests.GUEST_POOL_GATES holds Rags out of the MET-POOL rather than merely out of her chair, so the modulus drops 10 -> 9 and the SAME times_slept=16 seats a different pair: 16%9 = 7 over [selys,krshia,olesm,pisces,relc,zevara,klbkch,wilovan,grimalkin] is WILOVAN (12,6) + GRIMALKIN (14,5), and her chair (12,5) is plain floor. A sleep to 17 moves the start to 8 and seats [grimalkin, selys]; she is still absent, and Wilovan leaves while Grimalkin stays, so the run also proves the SHORTER cycle is a real cycle and not a frozen window. The exhaustive 'never once across a full rotation' leg is unit-pinned in test_inn_guests (t=0..19, all ten chatted, rags_meeting_settled unbanked); a live script cannot afford ten sleeps and does not need to. Boot = fixture->manual slot, title Continue (down 1).

steps._comment: Same 23 as inn_guests_ext_loop's boot -- two seats, always two seats. The pair is DIFFERENT, though, and that is the proof: a met-but-ungated roster member does not just skip her turn, she leaves the pool, which re-bases the modulus for everybody.
HER CHAIR IS FLOOR: (12,5) is directly south of the boot cell, and with the gate unbanked the walk lands ON it instead of opening a conversation. Structural absence, exactly like an off-shift guest.
WILOVAN IS SEATED IN HER PLACE: start 7 over the nine-name pool seats him at (12,6). Approached from (11,6), plain floor west of his chair; Rags's empty (12,5) is directly above him.
== THE SHORTER CYCLE STILL TURNS == a real sleep takes times_slept 16 -> 17 and the start 7 -> 8 over the same nine: [grimalkin, selys]. Wilovan leaves, Grimalkin stays, Rags is still nowhere.
24, not 23: the sleep banked garden_door_unlocked and the always-authored garden_door (3,8) turned present. Still exactly two guests.
Her chair is STILL floor a whole waking later, which no window position can explain -- only the pool gate can.
